description:
`FieldPoly::batch_gcd` in `crates/gf2-core/src/field/poly.rs` folds its inputs linearly. A divide-and-conquer batch GCD lowers the cost for many inputs.

## Background

The Rustdoc of `batch_gcd` named the divide-and-conquer form as an algorithmic upgrade; the source-comment sweep removed that statement, and this issue tracks it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `batch_gcd` returns the same result as the linear fold for every input of a shared property test over the supported fields, including a single polynomial and zero polynomials.
- [hard] REQ-02: The Rustdoc of `batch_gcd` states its complexity, verified against the implementation.
- [aspirational] REQ-03: A committed benchmark receipt from an uncontended host shows the input size above which the divide-and-conquer form is faster than the linear fold.
title: Divide-and-conquer batch GCD for FieldPoly
